method: Reuse-by-construction parity. WS3 is route-level only: read-only chain query from api.scan_log + write-time pin propagation through ScanRuntime.kickoff. The scoring engine path is the same _kickoff_live_probe_scan() entrypoint as /scans (WS1 sentry remains green: tests/test_rescans_handler_beaaa1265.py::test_rescan_and_scan_share_kickoff_entrypoint). The delta on any golden total or subscore is therefore 0 by construction — no separate code path for the engine to diverge in. The WS3 additive fields (`prior_scan_refs[]`, `forensic_bundle_uri`, `snapshot_hash`, `prior_scan_refs_truncated`) do NOT feed back into the scoring path; they are computed from the already-committed score envelope in the persisted scan_log row. Verified by tests/test_rescans_prior_scan_refs_beaaa1273.py::test_n5_calibration_chain_additions_do_not_perturb_baseline (5 replicate /rescans vs /scans baseline — shared envelope keys identical, additive WS3 keys present + stable).

adr_0017_section_7_q2_resolution.question: If an agent accumulates many rescans over a long policy term, the array could grow large. Flag if a pagination scheme is needed before v1.2.0 merges, or propose a max-entries cap with a separate history endpoint as a v1.3.0 follow-on.
adr_0017_section_7_q2_resolution.resolution: Max-entries cap = 100 in v1.2.0. If a /rescans POST would produce >100 prior_scan_refs entries, return the most-recent 100 (truncated from the head end ascending — keep the most-recent tail by run_timestamp) and add a non-breaking sentinel field `prior_scan_refs_truncated: true` on the response. A separate GET /scanner/v1/agents/{agent_id}/scans history endpoint is deferred to v1.3.0.
adr_0017_section_7_q2_resolution.rationale: At the expected first-bind-to-claim cadence (≤1 rescan/quarter Tier-1, ≤1 rescan/month Tier-2), 100 entries covers 25y Tier-1 / 8y Tier-2 — well past the Underwriter retention window. The cap is operational defense-in-depth, not a hot path. The persisted scan_log row count is unbounded (no row eviction); the cap only constrains the wire-response footprint.
adr_0017_section_7_q2_resolution.carry_to_cto_ratification: WS7 (ADR-0017 §7 Q2 close-out comment). CTO may override the cap at ratification; the constant is a single-line change.

commentary: Route-level surface change (api/scan_handlers.py — ScanRuntime persistence wiring + rescan response augmentation; api/scan_log.py — `check_same_thread=False` for FastAPI threadpool access). Zero rubric, judge, probe-runner, or scoring-math touch (anti-pattern auto-reject asserted). The L1 deterministic gate is byte-identical because the scoring engine code path is unchanged; the WS3 additive fields are derived from the WS2 scan_log row (`forensic_bundle_uri`, `snapshot_hash`) and the chain projection (`prior_scan_refs[]`), both of which are read-only on score data. Supreme Law gate: PASS — no fixture moves >1 on are_total or any subscore. The chain-immutability invariant (ADR-0017 §2.1) is verified explicitly: tests/test_rescans_prior_scan_refs_beaaa1273.py::test_three_step_chain_immutability_under_rubric_change asserts that past prior_scan_refs entries are NOT recomputed even when the score_envelope_factory swaps between rescans (simulating a rubric change between scans).
